facts.fact: Brands can use customer data platforms (CDPs) and data management platforms (DMPs) to consolidate data from ad campaigns, CRM, and customer interactions into one accessible source.
facts.quote: By leveraging customer data platforms (CDPs) and data management platforms (DMPs), brands can consolidate data from ad campaigns, CRM, and customer interactions into one accessible source.

facts.fact: The article describes CDPs as the "connective tissue" that lets marketers track and engage customers fluidly from brand awareness to demand generation and loyalty.
facts.quote: CDPs serve as the “connective tissue,” allowing marketers to track and engage customers fluidly from brand awareness to demand generation and ultimately loyalty.

facts.fact: The article suggests CRM data can target unaware accounts with high-impact ads, engage high-intent prospects with low-funnel display or native ads, and show knowledge-based ads to existing customers.
facts.quote: CRM data can target unaware accounts with high-impact ads, engage high-intent prospects with low-funnel display or native ads, and show knowledge-based ads to existing customers

facts.fact: The article gives an example in which a new product announcement is promoted through native ads, then an email series to high-interest leads, then retargeted display ads.
facts.quote: a new product announcement could be simultaneously promoted through native ads, followed by an email series to high-interest leads, and retargeted display ads for increased brand recall.
